records.source: Ah, the new farmer we've all been expecting... and whose arrival has sparked many a conversation!#$b#I'm Elliott... I live in the little cabin by the beach. It's a pleasure to meet you.
records.translation: 啊，你就是大家一直期盼的新農夫……你的到來已引發了無數話題！#$b#我是艾利歐特……住在海灘旁的小木屋。很高興認識你。

records.source: I'm honored that you would remember my birthday! Thank you!$h
records.translation: 你竟然記得我的生日，令我深感榮幸！謝謝！$h

records.source: Another year gone by, another gray hair... I suppose this gift can commemorate my decline.$s
records.translation: 又一年過去，又多了一根白髮……我想這份禮物正好可以紀念我的衰老。$s

records.source: Ah, what a gift! The aroma alone is inspiring...
records.translation: 啊，多麼美妙的禮物！光是香氣就令人靈感泉湧……

records.source: Of course... it would be an honor! I look forward to it.$h
records.translation: 當然……這將是我的榮幸！我很期待。$h

records.source: Ah, you've been doing some beach combing... A fine hobby! Thank you.
records.translation: 啊，你去海灘尋寶了……多麼優雅的嗜好！謝謝。

records.source: Ah, a book... Yes, perhaps the prose within these pages will offer a new insight. Thank you.
records.translation: 啊，一本書……沒錯，也許書頁中的文字會帶來新的啟發。謝謝。

records.source: Ah, a bottle of fine ink. A writer can never have too much... and it's quite expensive! Thank you!$h
records.translation: 啊，一瓶上等墨水。對作家而言永遠不嫌多……而且它相當昂貴！謝謝！$h

records.source: This will make a beautiful quill! I feel inspired already...$h
records.translation: 它能做成一支漂亮的羽毛筆！我已經感受到靈感了……$h

records.source: It's rare to see so many people at the beach. All for the love of squid!
records.translation: 很少見到這麼多人齊聚海灘。全都是出於對魷魚的熱愛！

records.source: Ah... please excuse the mess in my cabin. I wasn't expecting anyone to enter!
records.translation: 啊……請原諒木屋裡的凌亂。我沒料到會有人進來！

records.source: Agh, it's still wriggling! Get that abomination away from me!$6 [154]
records.translation: 啊，它還在扭動！快把那個怪物拿開！$6 [154]

records.source: Agh, it's still wriggling! Get that abomination away from me!$6 [155]
records.translation: 啊，它還在扭動！快把那個怪物拿開！$6 [155]

records.source: I only wish I had given you a bouquet first!$l
records.translation: 只可惜沒能由我先送你花束！$l

records.source: %Elliott whispers a sweet secret into your ear.
records.translation: %Elliott在你耳邊低語一個甜蜜的祕密。

records.source: You've plucked Pelican Town's finest flower... Now, you must care for it with all your heart.
records.translation: 你摘下了鵜鶘鎮最美的花朵……如今，必須全心全意地呵護它。

records.source: Well, if it isn't the town's number one ice fisher! That was truly an impressive performance.$h#$e#I never stand a chance, but I always participate just to be sporting.
records.translation: 哎呀，這不是鎮上的頭號冰釣高手嗎！那場表現確實令人驚嘆。$h#$e#我從來沒有勝算，但為了展現運動家精神，總會參加。

records.source: Did you know? A duck's feather makes for an excellent quill.
records.translation: 你知道嗎？鴨子的羽毛能製成絕佳的羽毛筆。

records.source: You've been very helpful... Now, I must think...
records.translation: 你幫了大忙……現在，我得好好思考……

records.source: I had a good time at the saloon the other day... Though my liver is not quite so enthusiastic...
records.translation: 前幾天我在酒館過得很愉快……不過我的肝臟似乎沒那麼開心……

records.source: That was quite the ride!
records.translation: 真是一趟精彩的航程！

records.source: I'll see you back in the valley.
records.translation: 回到山谷再見。

records.source: Hopefully a crab hasn't snuck onto my clothes again.$s#$b#Imagine crawling out of a pocket and finding yourself on a beach hundreds of miles from home!$h#$e#Hmmm... Perhaps this could make for an interesting novel...
records.translation: 希望沒有螃蟹再次偷偷爬上我的衣服。$s#$b#想像一下，從口袋裡爬出來，卻發現自己身在離家數百英里的海灘！$h#$e#嗯……也許這能寫成一本有趣的小說……

records.source: I'm just taking a quick break to slather some coconut oil on my body.$h
records.translation: 我只是稍作休息，在身上塗些椰子油。$h

records.source: Gus, I'll order a round for everyone!#$b#*hic*... Oh... I don't have the G.$s#$b#Heh heh... Never mind!
records.translation: 格斯，我要請大家喝一輪！#$b#*嗝*……喔……我身上沒有金幣。$s#$b#嘿嘿……當我沒說！

records.source: I've heard rumors of pirates coming to shore near here at night. They say it can get pretty wild!
records.translation: 我聽說夜裡會有海盜在附近登岸。據說場面會變得相當瘋狂！

records.source: I must admit, this beach blows my own humble strand out of the water.
records.translation: 我得承認，這片海灘遠勝過我家門前那條寒酸的沙岸。

records.source: Oh dear! Some seaweed has tangled itself in my hair.#$e#That's the trouble with relaxing on the beach.
records.translation: 喔，天啊！有些海藻纏進了我的頭髮。#$e#這就是在海灘放鬆的麻煩之處。

records.source: Yes... could I refuse that soft, kind face? The touch of spring-time's sweet embrace?
records.translation: 好……面對那張溫柔善良的臉龐，面對春日甜美的擁抱，我怎能拒絕？

records.source: Excuse me... not today.$s
records.translation: 抱歉……今天不行。$s

records.source: ...$s#$e#Why do you torment me? Can't you see you've shattered all my hopes and dreams?$s
records.translation: ……$s#$e#為什麼要折磨我？難道你看不出，自己已粉碎了我所有的希望與夢想嗎？$s

records.source: Go away. I can't bear to see you.$s
records.translation: 走開。我無法忍受看見你。$s

records.source: You've hurt me beyond measure... but I'm willing to leave the past behind us.$s
records.translation: 你帶給我的傷害無法衡量……但我願意讓過去留在身後。$s

records.source: Ah... the wilted bouquet. A sight I'd hoped to never see...$s#$b#I suppose there are other horizons to set my eyes upon...$s
records.translation: 啊……枯萎的花束。我曾希望永遠不必看見這一幕……$s#$b#我想，還有其他地平線值得我眺望……$s

records.source: I'm kind of new to this town myself, but I really feel at home.$h#$e#I moved here only a year before you.
records.translation: 我自己也算是這座小鎮的新人，卻真的有種家的感覺。$h#$e#我只比你早一年搬來。

records.source: I hope you've come to think of this place as 'home'.
records.translation: 希望你已開始把這裡視為「家」。

records.source: A great idea can pass through your head when you least expect it... but if your mind is too busy you might miss it.#$e#Well, I really must get back to my work.
records.translation: 偉大的點子可能在你最意想不到時掠過腦海……但要是思緒太過繁忙，也許就會錯過。#$e#好了，我真的得回去工作。

records.source: The sweet friction of pen and paper is the music of my soul.$u#$b#That's why I chose this beach as my home, so that I could have peace and quiet to do my work.
records.translation: 筆尖與紙張的甜美摩擦，是我靈魂的樂章。$u#$b#正因如此，我選擇以這片海灘為家，好讓自己能在寧靜中工作。

records.source: The forest is a wonderful place. Have you been there?
records.translation: 森林是個美妙的地方。你去過嗎？

records.source: Sorry, I'm feeling morose today.$s#$e#I wish there was more certainty about the future.$s#$e#I don't want to grow old as a lonely hermit on this beach...$s
records.translation: 抱歉，我今天有些憂鬱。$s#$e#真希望未來能更加確定。$s#$e#我不想以孤獨隱士的身分，在這片海灘上漸漸老去……$s

records.source: I can't seem to find the inspiration to begin writing my novel...$s
records.translation: 我似乎找不到動筆寫小說的靈感……$s

records.source: I've been feeling hopeful lately. Perhaps the weather is changing.
records.translation: 最近我心中充滿希望。也許天氣正在轉變。

records.source: Sometimes I wonder if I might just have an inflated self-image and no real skills...$s#$e#No, no... I'm not fishing for compliments. Though they are appreciated...
records.translation: 有時我會懷疑，自己是否只是過度自負，其實毫無真才實學……$s#$e#不，不……我不是在討讚美。雖然有人讚美，我會很感激……

records.source: #$1 elliottApol#It's a little lonely out here on the beach... so I apologize if I was ever a little too forward with you when we first met. I was just eager to have a friend.$k#$e#It feels good to have a close friend like you.
records.translation: #$1 elliottApol#獨自住在海灘上有些寂寞……所以我們剛認識時，如果我曾顯得太過熱切，還請原諒。我只是渴望有個朋友。$k#$e#能有你這樣的摯友，感覺真好。

records.source: Hello, @.#$e#Are you well?
records.translation: 你好，@。#$e#一切安好嗎？

records.source: The fresh air of this valley is good for body and mind.#$e#A quick stroll outdoors always invigorates me.
records.translation: 山谷裡的新鮮空氣有益身心。#$e#到戶外短暫散步，總能讓我恢復活力。

records.source: Ah... do not get too close to my hair with a torch...$8
records.translation: 啊……拿著火把時，別靠我的頭髮太近……$8

records.source: I'll admit... it takes me several hours each morning to make my hair look this good.
records.translation: 我得承認……每天早上都要花上好幾個小時，才能讓頭髮如此完美。
